description: progressively reveals text one letter or one word at a time.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: Welcome to tp-components. Make your words appear progressively.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds before the first reveal and between repetitions.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Repeats the reveal after the complete text has been displayed.

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: Letters per second, or words per second with word; zero pauses the reveal.

attributes.name: word
attributes.description: Reveals whole words instead of Unicode grapheme clusters.

methods.name: attachSpeech(controller: HTMLElement): void
methods.description: Gives a speech component ownership; content remains visible until a word boundary arrives.

methods.name: beginSpeech(controller: HTMLElement): void
methods.description: Prepares a reading; unsupported boundary reporting leaves the complete text visible.

methods.name: detachSpeech(controller: HTMLElement): void
methods.description: Releases ownership without letting an obsolete controller affect a newer one.

methods.name: endSpeech(controller: HTMLElement): void
methods.description: Restores the complete text after speech ends, stops or fails.

methods.name: getSpeechText(): string
methods.description: Returns the exact readable text, including separators between block elements.

methods.name: revealSpeech(controller: HTMLElement, charIndex: number): void
methods.description: Reveals through the word at a Web Speech UTF-16 character offset.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-typewriting>` element implements the Typewriting functionality: progressively reveals text one letter or one word at a time.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Animated text | Watch the text appear progressively. Space is reserved for the complete content to avoid layout shifts. |
| Click the component | Reveal all text immediately and stop repetition. Embedded links and controls retain their own actions. |
| Linked speech controls | Speak starts the spoken reveal; Pause and Resume freeze and continue it. Stop shows all text. Clicking the text shows it without interrupting the audio. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focus the animated component or a control inside it to reveal all text and stop repetition. No extra focus stop remains after completion. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |

keyboard.description: Focus the component to reveal all text and stop the animation.
